instruction: I'd like to use Ask as my primary search engine when browsing.

metadata.explanation: Variation 4: Change default search engine to Ask. Uses existing get_default_search_engine getter and match_in_list metric. Evaluator accepts both 'Ask' and 'Ask.com' as valid names.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts default search engine from Chrome Preferences file (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name)
Metric (match_in_list) performs appropriate exact string matching for search engine name
Expected values include both 'Ask' and 'Ask.com' to handle potential naming variations
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the only requirement in the instruction (set Ask as default search engine)
State is accessible: Chrome preferences file can be read after Chrome is closed
